arxiv-2007-14546.title: MLR-SNet: Transferable LR Schedules for Heterogeneous Tasks
arxiv-2007-14546.creator: Jun Shu*, Yanwen Zhu*, Qian Zhao, Zongben Xu, and Deyu Meng
arxiv-2007-14546.description: Abstract The learning rate (LR) is one of the most important hyper-parameters in stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithm for training deep neural networks (DNN). However, current hand-designed LR schedules need to manually pre-specify a fixed form, which limits their ability to adapt practical non-convex optimization problems due to the significant diversification of training dynamics.

arxiv-2105-14332.title: Performance of Non-Parametric Reconstruction Techniques in the Late-Time Universe
arxiv-2105-14332.creator: and Jurgen Mifsud
arxiv-2105-14332.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by and Jurgen Mifsud. In the context of a Hubble tension problem that is growing in its statistical significance, we reconsider the effectiveness of non-parametric reconstruction techniques which are independent of prescriptive cosmological models. By taking cosmic chronometers, Type Ia Supernovae and baryonic acoustic oscillation data, we compare and contrast two important reconstruction approaches, namely Gaussian processes (GP) and the Lo cally w e ighted S catterplot S moothing together with Sim ulation and ex trapolation method (LOESS-Simex or LS).

arxiv-2112-02977.title: Near-Infrared Polarization from Unresolved Disks Around Brown Dwarfs and Young Stellar Objects Journal: The Astrophysical Journal Facilities: Perkins Telescope Observatory (Mimir), and CDS (Vizier ( Ochsenbein et al. 2000 ) ) SAOImage DS9 ( Joye & Mandel 2003 ) ; and topcat ( Taylor 2005 )
arxiv-2112-02977.creator: Dan P. Clemens, Thushara G.S. Pillai, Anneliese M. Rilinger, Catherine C. Espaillat
arxiv-2112-02977.description: Abstract Wide-field near-infrared (NIR) polarimetry was used to examine disk systems around two brown dwarfs (BD) and two young stellar objects (YSO) embedded in the Heiles Cloud 2 (HCl2) dark molecular cloud in Taurus as well as numerous stars located behind HCl2.

arxiv-2208-03716.title: On Control Networks Over Finite Lattices
arxiv-2208-03716.creator: Zhengping JI, Daizhan CHENG
arxiv-2208-03716.description: Abstract The modelling and control of networks over finite lattices are studied via the algebraic state space approach. Using the semi-tensor product of matrices, we obtain the algebraic state space representation of the dynamics of (control) networks over finite lattices.

arxiv-2304-04473.title: A simple and efficient route towards improved energetics within the framework of density-corrected density functional theory
arxiv-2304-04473.creator: Daniel Graf, Alex J. W. Thom
arxiv-2304-04473.description: Abstract The crucial step in density-corrected Hartree–Fock density functional theory (DC(HF)-DFT) is to decide whether the density produced by the density functional for a specific calculation is erroneous and hence should be replaced by, in this case, the HF density.

arxiv-2305-14352.title: An Extensible Multimodal Multi-task Object Dataset with Materials
arxiv-2305-14352.creator: Trevor Standley Ruohan Gao Dawn Chen Jiajun Wu Silvio Savaresetstand@cs.stanford.edu http://emma.stanford.edu/, Stanford University Google Inc. Salesforce Research
arxiv-2305-14352.description: Abstract We present EMMa, an E xtensible, M ultimodal dataset of Amazon product listings that contains rich Ma terial annotations. It contains more than 2.8 million objects, each with image(s), listing text, mass, price, product ratings, and position in Amazon’s product-category taxonomy. We also design a comprehensive taxonomy of 182 physical materials (e.g., Plastic → \rightarrow Thermoplastic → \rightarrow Acrylic).

arxiv-2308-08385.title: A Characterization of concave mappings Thanks: The authors were partially supported by Fondecyt Grants # 1190756. Key words: Concave mappings, Schwarzian derivative, Caratheodory class. 2020 AMS Subject Classification . Primary: 30C45, 30C55; Secondary: 31A10.
arxiv-2308-08385.creator: V. Bravo and R. Hernández and O. Venegas
arxiv-2308-08385.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by V. Bravo and R. Hernández and O. Venegas. This study focuses on Concave mappings, a class of univalent functions that exhibit a unique property: they map the unit disk onto a domain whose complement is convex.

arxiv-2402-00465.title: Coded Multi-User Information Retrieval with a Multi-Antenna Helper Node This research has been supported by the Academy of Finland, 6G Flagship program under Grants 346208, 343586 (CAMAIDE), and by the Finnish-American Research and Innovation Accelerator (FARIA).
arxiv-2402-00465.creator: Milad Abolpour, MohammadJavad Salehi, Soheil Mohajer, Seyed Pooya Shariatpanahi, and Antti Tölli, Milad Abolpour 1 , MohammadJavad Salehi 1 , Soheil Mohajer 2 , Seyed Pooya Shariatpanahi 3 , and Antti Tölli 1
arxiv-2402-00465.description: Abstract A novel coding design is proposed to enhance information retrieval in a wireless network of users with partial access to the data, in the sense of observation, measurement, computation, or storage. Information exchange in the network is assisted by a multi-antenna base station (BS), with no direct access to the data.

arxiv-2501-10916.title: Inequalities and asymptotics for hook lengths in ℓ \ell -regular partitions and ℓ \ell -distinct partitions
arxiv-2501-10916.creator: Eunmi Kim
arxiv-2501-10916.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Eunmi Kim. In this article, we study hook lengths in ℓ \ell -regular partitions and ℓ \ell -distinct partitions. More precisely, we establish hook length inequalities between ℓ \ell -regular partitions and ℓ \ell -distinct partitions for hook lengths 2 2 and 3 3 , by deriving asymptotic formulas for the total number of hooks of length t t in both partition classes, for t = 1 , 2 , 3 t=1,2,3 .

arxiv-2503-00933.title: Time-evolution of parity-odd cascades in homogeneous Abelian and non-Abelian media with chiral imbalance
arxiv-2503-00933.creator: Jeremy Hansen, Kirill Tuchin
arxiv-2503-00933.description: Abstract We study radiation by a fast particle in a medium with a finite chiral chemical potential. The medium’s anomalous response encompasses the chiral magnetic effect, enabling novel chiral Cherenkov and pair production processes. The kinematics of the corresponding cascades is fundamentally different from conventional cascades. Notably, it is not dominated by the strong ordering of momenta.

arxiv-2505-22319.title: Localization behavior in a Hermitian and non-Hermitian Raman lattice
arxiv-2505-22319.creator: Entong Zhao, Yu-Jun Liu, Ka Kwan Pak, Peng Ren, Mengbo Guo, Chengdong He, Gyu-Boong Jo
arxiv-2505-22319.description: Abstract We propose a flexible Raman lattice system for alkaline-earth-like atoms to theoretically investigate localization behaviors in a quasi-periodic lattice with controllable non-Hermiticity. Our analysis demonstrates that critical phases and mobility edges can arise by adjusting spin-dependence of the incommensurate potentials in the Hermitian regime.

arxiv-2509-10080.title: BEVTraj: Map-Free End-to-End Trajectory Prediction in Bird’s-Eye View with Deformable Attention and Sparse Goal Proposals
arxiv-2509-10080.creator: Minsang Kong, Myeongjun Kim, Sang Gu Kang, Sang Hun Lee
arxiv-2509-10080.description: Abstract In autonomous driving, trajectory prediction is essential for ensuring safe and efficient navigation. To improve prediction accuracy, recent approaches often rely on pre-built high-definition (HD) maps or real-time local map construction modules to incorporate static environmental information. However, pre-built HD maps are limited to specific regions and cannot adapt to transient changes.

arxiv-2511-06893.title: DeepBooTS: Dual‑Stream Residual Boosting for Drift‑Resilient Time‑Series Forecasting
arxiv-2511-06893.creator: Daojun Liang, Jing Chen, Xiao Wang, Yinglong Wang, Suo Li
arxiv-2511-06893.description: Abstract Time-Series (TS) exhibits pronounced non-stationarity. Consequently, most forecasting methods display compromised robustness to concept drift, despite the prevalent application of instance normalization. We tackle this challenge by first analysing concept drift through a bias-variance lens and proving that weighted ensemble reduces variance without increasing bias.

pmc-10695966.title: Introducing MEG-MASC a high-quality magneto-encephalography dataset for evaluating natural speech processing
pmc-10695966.creator: Laura Gwilliams, Graham Flick, Alec Marantz, Liina Pylkkänen, David Poeppel, Jean-Rémi King
pmc-10695966.description: The “MEG-MASC” dataset provides a curated set of raw magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings of 27 English speakers who listened to two hours of naturalistic stories. Each participant performed two identical sessions, involving listening to four fictional stories from the Manually Annotated Sub-Corpus (MASC) intermixed with random word lists and comprehension questions.

pmc-11847881.title: Evaluating the relative predictive validity of measures of self-referential processing for depressive symptom severity
pmc-11847881.creator: Ethel Siew Ee Tan, Hong Ming Tan, Kah Vui Fong, Sheryl Yu Xuan Tey, Nikita Rane, Chong Wei Ho, Zhao Yuan Tan, Rachel Jing Min Ong, Chloe Teo, Jerall Yu, Maxine Lee, An Rae Teo, Sin Kee Ong, Xin Ying Lim, Jin Lin Kee, Jussi Keppo, Geoffrey Chern-Yee Tan
pmc-11847881.description: IntroductionThe self-referential encoding task (SRET) has a number of implicit measures which are associated with various facets of depression, including depressive symptoms. While some measures have proven robust in predicting depressive symptoms, their effectiveness can vary depending on the methodology used.

pmc-12463974.title: Two cases of combined immunodeficiency with ITPR3 mutations presenting with life-threatening severe EBV-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis
pmc-12463974.creator: Lang Yu, Yulin Li, Liwen Zhang, Wenhui Li, Ming Sun, Yunfei An, Hao Xiong, Peina Jin, Xiaodong Zhao
pmc-12463974.description: IntroductionITPR3 encodes a subunit of the inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor (IP3R), which forms a Ca2+ channel on the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane responsible for ER Ca2+ release. Recently, both autosomal dominant and recessive ITPR3 mutations have been reported in association with combined immunodeficiency (CID), accompanied by multisystem manifestations including neurological involvement.

pmc-13408240.title: 6-month symptom changes and factors associated with treatment response following combined acupuncture, moxibustion, and cupping protocol in patients with primary tinnitus: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13408240.creator: Yi Zhu, Ke Fang, Lianqiang Fang, Jie Zhou, Minghui Zhao, Hantong Hu, Da Jiang, Hong Gao, Yang Li
pmc-13408240.description: BackgroundPrimary tinnitus is a highly prevalent auditory disorder, affecting approximately 14.4% of adults globally. Conventional interventions yield limited efficacy. Although acupuncture-based TCM interventions is widely applied for tinnitus management, robust evidence regarding 6-month sustained symptom changes following combined TCM intervention and factors associated with treatment response remains scarce.

pmc-13415787.title: Socioeconomic disparities and life's essential 8: a focused review and considerations for improving cardiovascular health in the United States
pmc-13415787.creator: Vikas Sunder, Jennifer Garrow, Erik Van Iterson, Kardie Tobb, Nichole Opet, Sandra Tsai, Emelia Asamoah, Parveen Garg, Aniruddha Singh, Juliana Namutebi, Oby Ibe, Mansi Patil, Traci Mitchell, Keith Ferdinand
pmc-13415787.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Socioeconomic disparities continue to impact cardiovascular outcomes in the United States and clinicians are increasingly faced with navigating barriers for patients of low socioeconomic status (SES). The purpose of this review is to briefly discuss unique challenges in this population and to identify resources and strategies for clinicians to help improve cardiovascular health (CVH) guided by the American Heart Association's Life's Essential 8 (LE8) domains.

pmc-13582362.title: Cross-economy stability of predictor rankings for adolescent school belonging and mathematics anxiety: an explainable machine-learning analysis of PISA 2022
pmc-13582362.creator: Yuan Liao, Qin Peng, Runlin Li
pmc-13582362.description: IntroductionSchool belonging and mathematics anxiety reflect distinct relational and motivational processes, but cross-economy comparisons can blur distinctions among psychological relationships, model-based importance, and questionnaire availability.MethodsWe analyzed Program for International Student Assessment (PISA) 2022 data from 613,744 students; outcome-valid samples comprised 561,339 students in 78 economies for school belonging and 475,792 students in 76 economies for mathematics anxiety.
